mapper.select: SELECT 100 - NVL(SUM(b.cash_amt),0) AS faceValue FROM FIN_CASH_INFO a INNER JOIN TG_CASH_PLAN b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE a.finprod_id = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} -- and a.cash_type = '' /**还本【yangjian-note,现金流类型无还本类型】**/ AND #{happenDate,jdbcType=DATE} > = b.mdate

select A.finprod_id finprodId, /*股票金融产品代码*/ A.finprod_type finprodType, /*股票金融产品类型*/ A.prin_amt cost, /*股票成本*/ A.share_amt Num /*转股数*/ ,B.type_2 as type2 from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID where A.trade_id = #{tradeId}
